authority: execution contract only; never creative, Gate 9, Gate 10, or publication authority

timeline.beat_rule: each beat is wholly inside one declared timing section: script-beat narration alignment for VISUAL_DRAFT or mode-appropriate human-performance boundaries for presenter/final paths; beats are contiguous and non-overlapping
timeline.audio_rule: the declared narration or human-performance audio spine is assembled once; visual beats never restart or redefine it

invariants: exactly one primary owner per beat
a visible presenter layer conditionally requires mode-appropriate presenter authority

zero PRESENTER_ONLY assets is legal for VISUAL_DRAFT and no dummy presenter posing as a human performance is accepted; the typed GENERIC_PRESENTER_PROXY final overlay (V2 grammar only) is not a presenter, claims no performance, and carries zero layout authority
absence of presenter makes the full 1080x1920 canvas available; a future-presenter safe region is optional metadata, not a global constraint
no raw ffmpeg filter text is accepted
duplicate full-frame assets and duplicate semantic typography are rejected
optional ADDITIVE_PERSIST reveal layers are absent before their explicit licensing onset and persist through the exclusive end of their owning beat
staged reveal order, intervals, licensing anchors, and required-layer census are explicit composition data compiled to deterministic beat-local frame indices; the renderer infers no timing
all assets are path-confined and SHA-256 bound
composition data participates in the frozen render-plan digest

additive_reveal.persistence: every required layer is absent before its first-visible frame, becomes visible on that frame, and remains visible through the final renderable beat frame
additive_reveal.legacy_behavior: layers and beats without reveal metadata retain their existing whole-beat behavior

v4_typography_layout.shape_rule: when typography.layout is present all four integer fields are required and unknown fields are rejected
v4_typography_layout.font_policy: the selected integer size is the largest fitting value between the approved min_font_size and max_font_size; min_font_size may raise but never lower the canonical 24px readability floor and max_font_size may not exceed 128px
v4_typography_layout.line_policy: canonical whitespace and emergency grapheme wrapping must fit at or below max_lines; authored newlines count; no truncation is permitted
v4_typography_layout.spacing_policy: line_spacing_px is the exact non-negative integer used by both FFmpeg measurement and final drawtext execution
v4_typography_layout.safety_authority: scripts/canonical-typography-layout.js remains the single FFmpeg-measured width, height, glyph-bound and final YUV-domain safety authority
v4_typography_layout.failure_policy: malformed, contradictory, max-line-exceeding or geometrically impossible layouts fail closed before rendering
v4_typography_layout.legacy_behavior: typography without layout retains its existing V1/V2/static behavior

drawtext_serialization.invocation_model: the filter graph is one direct spawnSync argv element; no shell parses it
drawtext_serialization.representation: inline drawtext text= inside a filtergraph single-quoted token
drawtext_serialization.escaping: backslash, colon and percent are escaped for the drawtext parsers; ASCII apostrophe closes the quoted token, emits an escaped literal quote, and reopens the token
drawtext_serialization.semantic_oracle: real FFmpeg output must be pixel-identical to rendering the same UTF-8 bytes through drawtext textfile= with expansion=none
drawtext_serialization.injection_policy: approved text remains data and cannot terminate options, inject filters, create pad labels, or alter enable/coordinate expressions

visual_media.presenter_matte_format_for_current_run: VP9-alpha WebM decoded explicitly with libvpx-vp9
visual_media.presenter_matte_alternative: ProRes 4444 remains supported where already available but is not required for the current run
visual_media.presenter_matte_rule: PRESENTER_ONLY derivatives require explicit alpha semantics, meaningful-alpha validation, a bounded derivative visual crop, immutable source-master lineage, and explicit source-time mapping; automatic decoder selection and extension-only dispatch are forbidden

preview.engine: same frozen plan and ffmpeg composition graph as full render

v2_grammar.flag: composition.grammar = VISUAL_DRAFT_V2_FULL_FRAME (opt-in, additive; absent = exact historical V1 semantics)
v2_grammar.doctrine_owner: config/visual-draft-production-doctrine-v1.json pinned via composition.doctrine {doctrine_id, version, binding_digest_sha256, file_sha256}
v2_grammar.timing_authority: FINAL PAUSED NARRATION (vidtoolz.finalPausedNarration.v1) — the renderer recomputes the four-second interval schedule from the paused sections and rejects any drift
invariants: every beat carries interval_id; intervals are contiguous, never span a narration section, and obey 119..121 frames (section-final 1..121)

one unique one-use background asset per interval; uniqueness authority is the canonical background identity (vidtoolz.backgroundIdentity.v1) — a content-addressed root lineage plus a canonical decoded-pixel fingerprint — never the caller's provenance wrapper: identical decoded pixels under any filename/encoding/metadata are the same background, canonical derivatives (crop/zoom/reframe/mirror/recolor/blur/treatment) inherit their parent's root, missing or stripped lineage fails closed, roots cannot be caller-minted (public content formula), and the renderer re-derives the fingerprint from the actual bytes (scripts/visual-draft-background-identity.js)
every V2 state keeps a full-frame background; a standalone graphic state is a justified typographic/deterministic background asset
V2 typography is white with a translucent GREY backing inside the doctrine opacity band and frame-safe margins; presenter overlap is legal, frame-edge violations are not

the PRESENTER_PROXY layer is a static, lower-right, <25%-area, alpha-validated final overlay above the complete primary frame, stable across all beats; primary_composition_digest_sha256 excludes it and must be identical with and without the proxy

the interval binding manifest (vidtoolz.visualDraftIntervalBinding.v1) is hash-pinned and validated: 100% coverage, exact spoken text per interval, zero generic filler, bound assets equal composed backgrounds

background_identity.schema: vidtoolz.backgroundIdentity.v2 (required on every V2 script-background manifest asset; forbidden on V1 manifests; carries asset_id and, for derivatives, the canonical parent's asset id)
background_identity.root_identity: sha256('VIDTOOLZ_BACKGROUND_ROOT_V1|' + pixel_fingerprint) for root classes; inherited from the verified parent for DERIVED_ASSET
background_identity.pixel_fingerprint: sha256('VIDTOOLZ_PIXELS_V1|w=<w>|h=<h>|fmt=rgba8_straight|' + first decoded frame as straight-alpha RGBA rawvideo, row-major top-down, no metadata/container)
background_identity.registration: scripts/visual-draft-background-identity.js#registerRootBackground / #registerDerivedBackground against the canonical background asset registry — identity derived from canonical content and registered state, never accepted from the caller; a derivative NAMES its parent by parent_asset_id and can never DEFINE it (BACKGROUND_PARENT_OBJECT_FORBIDDEN); an unregistered, fabricated, copied, or missing parent fails closed (BACKGROUND_PARENT_NOT_REGISTERED) and never becomes a new root
background_identity.resolution: scripts/production-assembly-renderer.js#validateV2Closure resolves every interval background against the pinned canonical registry and from bytes (#resolveBackgroundIdentity, #verifyLineageFromBytes); composition validation enforces shape/formula/uniqueness purely and requires the record to describe its own manifest asset
background_identity.uniqueness_domain: one VISUAL_DRAFT programme (a single FULL_PROGRAMME composition): one root and one decoded-pixel identity per timed interval; no global cross-project ban
background_identity.trust_boundary: an externally transformed, lineage-destroyed import beyond exact decoded-pixel equality would require perceptual similarity to relate — deliberately out of scope; the canonical pipeline's own paths cannot strip lineage and exact decoded duplicates are caught regardless of wrapper

registry.shape: append-only digest-chained records (predecessor_record_digest_sha256 + record_digest_sha256), one registry per uniqueness domain (one VISUAL_DRAFT programme/run)
registry.pin: composition.background_registry {path, sha256} is required under the V2 grammar; the renderer hash-verifies and chain-verifies it, requires every used background to be REGISTERED with a manifest identity equal to the canonical record, and re-derives used assets' AND their ancestors' fingerprints from bytes
registry.authority_note: integrity is not authority: valid hashes and valid formulas do not make a record canonical — registration in the chain does; registry unavailable => fail closed, inline parent objects are never a fallback
registry.repair_provenance: closes Codex defect DERIVED ASSET PATH CAN DROP ROOT LINEAGE (SUCCESSOR-PROVENANCE-ATTACK.json, ce2e6e1 certification 2026-08-30)
